baseline_race_reproduction.scenario: An earlier model JSON read resolves after a newer selection
baseline_race_reproduction.scope: Deterministic original viewer test fixture, not a Minecraft runtime test

contracts: Latest model, texture and archive request wins
Superseded failures cannot clear the current preview
Inflated entry accumulation stops at declared size or32MiB cap
Stored entries must match declared uncompressed length
PNG capture is gated on a ready preview
Keyboard orbit and hidden-page autorotation pause
Geometry conversion and rasterization unchanged apart from readiness gate
PNG filenames are captured at request time and newer export requests win
limits: Original documentation viewer tests, not mod/game execution
No GPU certification or comprehensive hostile-archive security audit
32MiB is an entry accumulation limit, not an absolute process-memory limit
